from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys

root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'.cache/low-copy'
env=dict(os.environ,CGO_ENABLED='0',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOAMD64='v1',GOMAXPROCS='16',GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false')
paths=['baseline.test','candidate.test','reference.test','stream-baseline.test','stream-candidate.test']
provenance={'time_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'phase0_checkpoint':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'go':subprocess.check_output(['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','version'],text=True).strip(),'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'conditions':'Isolated alternating pairs/triples; 7x500ms; same Go1.26.8 CGO0 GOAMD64v1 PGOoff; default GC/memory; unpinned. Original workloads serial/initial P16; matched leaves actual P1; resource/stream contention leaves P1/P16 asserted; no builds/lint/fuzz/reviewer tools.','sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((out/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}}
(out/'paired-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'candidate.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary']))
def sample(family,role,selector,round_number,duration='500ms'):
    binary=out/(('stream-' if family.startswith('stream') else '')+role+'.test')
    args=[str(binary),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench='+selector,'-test.benchtime='+duration,'-test.count=1','-test.benchmem']
    result=subprocess.run(args,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    rows=[line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('Benchmark')]
    assert len(rows)==1,(family,role,selector,rows,result.stdout)
    fields=rows[0].split()
    if family!='original':
        metric='actual-procs'
        actual=float(fields[fields.index(metric)-1]); match=re.search(r'/P(\d+)/',fields[0]); expected=int(match.group(1)) if match else 1
        assert actual==expected,rows[0]
    with (out/(family+'-'+role+'.txt')).open('a') as log:
        print('ROUND',round_number,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),file=log)
        print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log)
        print(result.stdout,file=log,flush=True)
def selector(*segments): return '/'.join('^'+segment+'$' for segment in segments)
original=['ObfuscateSQL','SketchAdd','SketchAddMany1k','ObfuscateTraces1k','ObfuscateSQLVaried','SketchAddVaried','SketchAddNegativeBins']
for number in range(1,8):
    roles=['baseline','candidate','reference'] if number%2 else ['reference','candidate','baseline']
    for name in original:
        for role in roles: sample('original',role,'^Benchmark'+name+'$',number)
    print('complete',number,'original',flush=True)
    for corpus in ['Repeated','Nearby','Unique','NegativeBins','Holdout']:
        for size in [1,32,1024,8192]:
            query=selector('BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch',corpus,'N'+str(size),'Facade')
            for role in roles: sample('matched',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'matched',flush=True)
    paired=roles if number%2 else roles
    paired=[r for r in paired if r!='reference']
    for processors,homes in [(1,1),(16,1),(16,16)]:
        for size in [32,1024]:
            query=selector('BenchmarkSketchBatchContention','P'+str(processors),'H'+str(homes),'N'+str(size),'Facade')
            for role in paired: sample('contention',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'contention',flush=True)
    for corpus in ['Fixed','Holdout']:
        for processors in [1,16]:
            for chunk in [64,4096]:
                query=selector('BenchmarkStreamStandalone',corpus,'P'+str(processors),'Chunk'+str(chunk),'Retain32')
                for role in paired: sample('stream-default',role,query,number)
        for path in ['StandaloneHomesP','BatchHomes1','BatchHomesP']:
            query=selector('BenchmarkStreamChecked',corpus,'P16','Chunk64','N32',path)
            for role in paired: sample('stream-checked',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'stream',flush=True)
print('paired qualification complete',flush=True)

===== prepare-reference.py SHA256=279c4c35e66f0ca14c5d675046d985a3057c8d4487daa6fa9cd8dc85363768c3 =====
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / '.cache/low-copy'
spike = Path('/home/dario/Code/cocoon-spike')
binaryen = root / '.cache/binaryen/binaryen-version_133/bin'
env = dict(os.environ, CGO_ENABLED='0', GOTOOLCHAIN='local', GOAMD64='v1', GOCACHE=str(root/'.cache/go'), GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false')
raw = out / 'reference-rust/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cocoon_dd_shim.wasm'
with (out/'reference-prepare.log').open('w') as log:
    with (out/'reference.graph.json').open('w') as graph:
        subprocess.run(['python3',str(spike/'tools_exports.py'),str(raw)],stdout=graph,check=True)
    features=['--enable-bulk-memory','--enable-sign-ext','--enable-nontrapping-float-to-int','--enable-mutable-globals','--enable-reference-types','--enable-multivalue']
    subprocess.run([str(binaryen/'wasm-metadce'),str(raw),'--graph-file',str(out/'reference.graph.json'),'-o',str(out/'reference.dce.wasm'),*features],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(binaryen/'wasm-opt'),'-O3',*features,str(out/'reference.dce.wasm'),'-o',str(out/'reference.final.wasm')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/go','tool','wasm2go','-unsafe','-pkg','ddwasm','-o',str(out/'reference-module.go'),str(out/'reference.final.wasm')],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run(['python3',str(spike/'tools_harden.py'),str(out/'reference-module.go')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    varied=(root/'examples/datadog/go/dd/varied_bench_test.go').read_text().replace('openTest(b, Options{Instances: 1})','open(b)').replace('openTest(t, Options{Instances: 1})','open(t)')
    negative=(root/'examples/datadog/go/dd/negative_bench_test.go').read_text().split('func TestSketchNegativeBinBenchmarkCorpus')[0].replace('openTest(b, Options{Instances: 1})','open(b)')
    (out/'reference-varied_test.go').write_text(varied)
    (out/'reference-negative_test.go').write_text(negative)
    source=(root/'examples/datadog/go/dd/batching_bench_test.go').read_text()
    values=source[source.index('func batchingValues('):source.index('func batchingAdd(')]
    matched='''package dd
import ("fmt";"math";"runtime";"testing")
'''+values+'''
func BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch(b *testing.B) {
for _,corpus:=range []string{"Repeated","Nearby","Unique","NegativeBins","Holdout"} {
for _,size:=range []int{1,32,1024,8192} {
for _,mode:=range []string{"Scalar","Facade"} {
b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d/%s",corpus,size,mode),func(b *testing.B){
previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil{b.Error(err)}})
values:=batchingValues(corpus,size)
add:=sketch.AddMany
if mode=="Scalar" {add=func(vs []float64)error{for _,v:=range vs{if err:=sketch.Add(v);err!=nil{return err}};return nil}}
if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.ReportAllocs();b.ResetTimer()
for b.Loop(){if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}
b.StopTimer()
if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=1{b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
b.ReportMetric(1,"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(size),"points/op")
b.ReportMetric(float64(size)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
if count,err:=sketch.Count();err!=nil||count!=float64(size)*float64(b.N+1){b.Fatal("count mismatch",count,err)}
})
}}}}
'''
    (out/'reference-matched_test.go').write_text(matched)
    overlay={'Replace':{
        str(spike/'go/internal/ddwasm/module.go'):str(out/'reference-module.go'),
        str(spike/'go/dd/testdata/shim.wasm'):str(out/'reference.final.wasm'),
        str(spike/'go/dd/varied_bench_test.go'):str(out/'reference-varied_test.go'),
        str(spike/'go/dd/negative_bench_test.go'):str(out/'reference-negative_test.go'),
        str(spike/'go/dd/matched_bench_test.go'):str(out/'reference-matched_test.go'),
    }}
    overlay_path=out/'reference-overlay.json';overlay_path.write_text(json.dumps(overlay,indent=2)+'\n')
    args=['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','test','-modfile='+str(root/'.cache/reference.mod'),'-overlay='+str(overlay_path),'-pgo=off']
    subprocess.run([*args,'./dd','-count=1'],cwd=spike/'go',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run([*args,'-c','-o',str(out/'reference.test'),'./dd'],cwd=spike/'go',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(out/'reference.test'),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench=^BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch$','-test.benchtime=1x'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
paths=[spike/'shim/Cargo.lock',spike/'shim/src/lib.rs',out/'reference.final.wasm',out/'reference-module.go',out/'reference.test']
(out/'reference-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sha256':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},'spike_head':'unversioned local source snapshot; no .git present', 'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(spike)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for area in ['shim','rust/cocoon-guest','rust/patches','go/dd','go/rt','go/internal/testpayload'] for p in sorted((spike/area).rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ['.go','.rs','.toml','.lock']} ,'notes':'Independent original Rust/Cargo ABI2; fresh std,panic_abort Rust1.97 build; Binaryen133 metaDCE/O3; wasm2go0.4.16 unsafe; reference own hardener. print('Reference rebuilt, original/wazero tests and matched one-iteration oracle passed.',flush=True)

===== reference-matched_test.go SHA256=3255ce2b841519c711a134f686407413482226b17a1ad956fbf3393111f92718 =====
package dd
import ("fmt";"math";"runtime";"testing")
func batchingValues(corpus string, size int) []float64 {
	values := make([]float64, size)
	negative := negativeBinSketchValues()
	for index := range values {
		switch corpus {
		case "Repeated":
			values[index] = 42
		case "Nearby":
			values[index] = 1 + float64(index)/float64(max(size, 1))
		case "Unique":
			values[index] = float64(index + 1)
		case "NegativeBins":
			values[index] = negative[index%len(negative)]
		case "Holdout":
			// Deterministic, nonmonotonic, broad exponents and varied mantissas.
			values[index] = math.Ldexp(1+float64((index*7919+104729)%65521)/65521, index%601-300)
		}
	}
	return values
}


func BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch(b *testing.B) {
for _,corpus:=range []string{"Repeated","Nearby","Unique","NegativeBins","Holdout"} {
for _,size:=range []int{1,32,1024,8192} {
for _,mode:=range []string{"Scalar","Facade"} {
b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d/%s",corpus,size,mode),func(b *testing.B){
previous:=runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);b.Cleanup(func(){runtime.GOMAXPROCS(previous)})
library:=open(b);sketch,err:=library.NewSketch();if err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.Cleanup(func(){if err:=sketch.Close();err!=nil{b.Error(err)}})
values:=batchingValues(corpus,size)
add:=sketch.AddMany
if mode=="Scalar" {add=func(vs []float64)error{for _,v:=range vs{if err:=sketch.Add(v);err!=nil{return err}};return nil}}
if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}
b.ReportAllocs();b.ResetTimer()
for b.Loop(){if err:=add(values);err!=nil{b.Fatal(err)}}
b.StopTimer()
if runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)!=1{b.Fatal("actual processor mismatch")}
b.ReportMetric(1,"actual-procs");b.ReportMetric(float64(size),"points/op")
b.ReportMetric(float64(size)*float64(b.N)/b.Elapsed().Seconds(),"points/s")
if count,err:=sketch.Count();err!=nil||count!=float64(size)*float64(b.N+1){b.Fatal("count mismatch",count,err)}
})
}}}}

===== reference-varied_test.go SHA256=83418403ba35153d90472814fe5647f209a52ee05dc191b5ec974edabb270736 =====
package dd

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// These varied inputs are held out from the PGO training benchmarks.
func variedSketchValues() [16]float64 {
	return [16]float64{
		0.01, 0.025, 0.125, 0.5,
		1.25, 3.75, 12.5, 42.25,
		100.5, 512, 1024.75, 8192,
		10000.25, 65536, 250000.5, 1000000,
	}
}

func variedSQLQueries() [8]string {
	return [8]string{
		"SELECT sku, price FROM catalog WHERE category = 'garden' AND price > 19.95",
		"SELECT shipment_id FROM shipments WHERE destination IN ('Oslo', 'Porto') AND priority = 3",
		"INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, action, sequence_no) VALUES ('operator-a', 'login', 8127)",
		"INSERT INTO stock_levels (sku, available) VALUES ('widget-42', 96)",
		"UPDATE invoices SET paid = true, memo = 'wire-transfer' WHERE invoice_no = 7351",
		"UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - 7 WHERE location = 'north-bin' AND product_id = 643",
		"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE account_id = 902 AND token = 'expired-token'",
		"DELETE FROM temp_readings WHERE station = 'ridge' AND recorded_at < '2026-01-01'",
	}
}

func BenchmarkSketchAddVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		b.Fatal(err)
	}
	b.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			b.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(values[index]); addErr != nil {
			b.Fatal(addErr)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(values)
	}
	b.StopTimer()
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(b.N) {
		b.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, b.N, countErr)
	}
}

func BenchmarkObfuscateSQLVaried(b *testing.B) {
	library := open(b)
	queries := variedSQLQueries()
	index := 0
	b.ReportAllocs()
	b.ResetTimer()
	for b.Loop() {
		output, err := library.ObfuscateSQL(b.Context(), queries[index])
		if err != nil || output == "" {
			b.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, err)
		}
		index = (index + 1) % len(queries)
	}
}

func TestVariedBenchmarkCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	library := open(t)
	sketch, err := library.NewSketch()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeErr := sketch.Close(); closeErr != nil {
			t.Error(closeErr)
		}
	})
	values := variedSketchValues()
	for index, value := range values {
		if addErr := sketch.Add(value); addErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("value %d rejected: %v", index, addErr)
		}
	}
	if count, countErr := sketch.Count(); countErr != nil || count != float64(len(values)) {
		t.Fatalf("point count = %g, want %d: %v", count, len(values), countErr)
	}
	for index, query := range variedSQLQueries() {
		output, sqlErr := library.ObfuscateSQL(t.Context(), query)
		if sqlErr != nil || !strings.Contains(output, "?") {
			t.Fatalf("query %d produced %q: %v", index, output, sqlErr)
		}
	}
}
